post.text:
⚠️WARNING: LEDGER SUFFERS A NEW DATA BREACH

As per ZachXBT, Ledger has suffered another data breach via its payment processor, Global-e.

The breach reportedly exposed customers’ personal information, including names and contact details. https://t.co/YjNBMMoEyR

description.description: The image features a white uppercase letter L centered within a square-shaped frame indicated by four L-shaped corners, all set against a solid black background.

A screenshot of a post by user ZachXBT on X (formerly Twitter) regarding a data breach involving Ledger and Global-e. The post includes a screenshot of an email sent to customers informing them of a security incident where personal data was improperly accessed.
description.ocrText: ZachXBT @zachxbt  Community alert: Ledger had another data breach via payment processor Global-e leaking the personal data of customers (name & other contact information). Earlier today customers received the email below. Dear Customer, Global-e recently identified unusual activity on a portion of our network. Immediately after we became aware of the unusual activity in our cloud systems we took action to contain and ultimately secure our systems. We retained independent forensic experts to conduct an investigation into the incident and were able to determine that some personal data including name and contact information were improperly accessed.
